notes.grok_distinct: fast=grok-4.3/low/scanner balanced=grok-4.7/high/architect top=grok-4.7/high/critic. Decision tree in the 2026-11-16 lineup: fast leaf grok-4.3; balanced and top are grok-4.7 (Grok Build default). They share the model and differ on perspective. Effort stays high, the documented Grok 4.7 default (low/medium/high/xhigh). xhigh is documented and not used here. Fast effort stays low; the lineup does not publish a separate effort set for Grok 4.3.
notes.codex_pro_mode: reasoning.mode pro on gpt-6.1-sol is not a separate slug. Decision-tree top is GPT-6 Astra, and the 2026-11-16 lineup records no CLI slug for Astra, so hosts.codex.top stays the models-page example default gpt-6.1-sol. Fast is gpt-6-luna. GPT-6.1 Terra (gpt-6.1-terra) is the fast-everyday tier and is not the decision-tree fast leaf.
